messages:
Aisha (sales): Heads up — Meridian SIG is due EOD Friday. Customer asked for itemized artifacts question-by-question. They specifically called out: screenshots for Q3.2 (SAML setup), network diagram for Q4.1, and KMS rotation proof for Q7.4. Can we assemble a ZIP and a short cover note?
Carlos (solutions): I can grab the infra diagram and a sanitized SSO screenshot. Which SAML tenant should I show — prod or demo?
Maya (security): Use demo only. DO NOT include any real usernames or tenant IDs. If you need sample logs, use the sanitized export in /shared/compliance/sig_samples.
Tom (sales-eng): I'll prep the cover note with the control mapping table (Q -> artifact). Prefer the ZIP be structured: /SIG/Meridian/{question_number}/{artifact_type}. Example: 3_2/screenshot.png, 4_1/network.pdf, 7_4/kms_rotation.pdf
Aisha (sales): Perfect. @J. Patel — can you confirm any additional ask from Meridian beyond those three?
J. Patel (customer): They want an export of the access review evidence too (Q5.6). Prefer CSV of last 90 days.
Carlos (solutions): I can run the access-review export, but will need a scrub script to remove emails. Maya, can we use the standard scrub pipeline?
Maya (security): Yes — use `scripts/scrub-pii.sh --sig-export`. It replaces emails with hashed-user-ids and removes IPs. Docs here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/scrub-pii.
Jake (legal): Reminder — remove any contractual references or customer names from screenshots. Also add the standard Non-Disclosure footer in the cover note.
Tom (sales-eng): Got it. I’ll add footer and a short chain-of-custody line: who produced each artifact + timestamp.
doc-bot: Uploaded file: https://files.redwoodcorp/internal/sig/meridian/meridian_controls_map_v1.xlsx
Carlos (solutions): I added a draft network diagram to the shared path: https://files.redwoodcorp/internal/sig/meridian/network_diagram_v2.pdf — it's the VPC + peering view they asked for.
Aisha (sales): Can someone confirm we have rotation logs for KMS (Q7.4) for the last 180 days? Customer might audit.
Maya (security): We have rotation metadata in KMS logs. I will export verifiable entries (key-id, rotation-date, rotation-authorizer) and sign them with our signing key before we hand over.
Carlos (solutions): Quick question about format — do they want signed PDF or a plain CSV + signature?
J. Patel (customer): Signed PDF preferred, one per key. Simpler for our audit team.
Tom (sales-eng): OK — I'll convert Maya's export to signed PDFs and add them to 7_4/.
Aisha (sales): ETA on the full ZIP? We need to send to Meridian's security mailbox by Friday 18:00 PST.
Maya (security): I can deliver signed KMS PDFs by Thursday EOD.
Carlos (solutions): Diagrams and screenshots by Thursday noon.
Tom (sales-eng): Cover note + CSV access export scrubbed by Thursday 3pm. Then I’ll assemble ZIP and run quick QA.
Aisha (sales): Nice. Jake — want to do a quick legal glance before we hit send?
Jake (legal): Yes. Ping me when the ZIP is ready; I’ll do a 30-min turnaround unless there’s PII slip.
Aisha (sales): Great. I'll set a reminder and create the outbound message.
Carlos (solutions): One more thing — for Q3.2 screenshot, include snippet of assertion attributes only (masked). Example in the screenshot: `NameID=***`, `email=***@example.com`
Maya (security): Add a short redaction checklist to the cover note: no ARNs, no real domains, no admin usernames.
Tom (sales-eng): Will do. Also updating the ZIP manifest with hashes for each file for integrity verification.
Aisha (sales): Awesome — team, please post any final artifacts to https://files.redwoodcorp/internal/sig/meridian/ before 2024-06-27 15:00 UTC so I can compile.
J. Patel (customer): Thanks all — Meridian security will review after we send. I’ll notify if they need anything else.
Aisha (sales): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Carlos (solutions): FYI I'm adding small HOWTO snippets for the reviewer so they can match artifacts to questions quickly.
Maya (security): Confirmed — scrubbed CSV placed: https://files.redwoodcorp/internal/sig/meridian/access_review_90d_scrubbed.csv
Tom (sales-eng): Draft ZIP assembled at https://files.redwoodcorp/internal/sig/meridian/meridian_SIG_package_draft.zip — waiting on KMS PDFs and legal signoff.
Jake (legal): Reviewing now. If anything flagged I'll annotate directly in the ZIP path.
Aisha (sales): If all good, I'll send and copy the support ticket number. Thanks!
